Description: Caster is aware of the presence of all thinking/ sentient beings within his range
Caster can check one object or place (up to a 5'R) and tell if it is an illusion or has an illusion on it
Caster stores the mental pattern of target; can be used later to locate specific person through Finding
Caster can determine one of the following concerning a target: profession, race, or level
Caster gets direction & distance to a unshielded mind which he has a mental pattern of from Mind Store
As Analysis, except caster learns race, profession, and level
As Presence, plus a general knowledge of the actions of each being (e.g., being is casting a spell, but not what spell is being cast
Caster's point of hearing may be moved up to 10'/ lvl away (moves at 10'/rnd); he must be physically able to go there (e.g., he could not send his point of hearing through walls or closed doors)
As Awareness III, except radius is 10'/ lvl
As Mind Store, except range is 100'/lvl if the target is sensed (mentally or by sight)
As Mind Typing, except range is 100'/ lvl if target is sensed (mentally or by sight)
As Minor Finding, except range is 1 mi/lvl
As Long Ear, except all senses are involved
As Minor Finding, except range is 5 miles/lvl
As Long Sense, except range is 1 mile/lvl
As Long Sense, except range is unlimited
As Finding, except no range limit. TRUE PERCEPTION
